name: Love ❤️
description: Handles the logistics of a relationship — tracking dates worth remembering, digging up gift ideas, and lining up bookings and outings for you to approve. Aimed at people whose intentions are fine but whose follow-through slips, not at anyone wanting the thinking done for them.

official.title: Love ❤️ by Danny
